# 🚨 Incident report

## Incident control
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Incident ID | |
| Severity | Critical / High / Medium / Low |
| Date discovered | |
| Incident owner | |
| Status | Open / Contained / Resolved / Closed |

## Executive summary
State what happened, what was affected, and current status without including unnecessary personal data.

## Impact assessment
Identify affected systems, public assets, user groups, data categories, exposure window, and known uncertainty.

## Timeline
| Time (UTC) | Event | Evidence/source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

## Detection and response
Describe how the incident was noticed, who was notified, what containment actions were taken, and whether public exposure continues.

## Root cause and contributing factors
Separate confirmed root cause from hypotheses.

## Resolution and verification
Describe the fix, deployment/revocation, validation performed, and any remaining risk.

## Lessons and follow-up
| Action | Owner | Priority | Due date | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | | |

Do not put exposed credentials or employee records in this report. Use a restricted evidence location and rotate exposed secrets promptly.
